config.really_radical_rolls.title: Really Radical Rolls
config.really_radical_rolls.client.title: Client
config.really_radical_rolls.client.gener: Master switch for the entire mod. When disabled, no rolling occurs.
Swap the roll and yaw axes. When enabled, horizontal mouse movement controls yaw instead of roll.
Invert the pitch axis. Pulling up will pitch down instead.
Use a momentum-based mouse input mode, similar to a joystick. The mouse cursor becomes a virtual stick.
Deadzone size for the momentum mouse mode. Higher values require more mouse movement before input registers.
Disable rolling when the player is underwater.
Display a visual horizon indicator at the center of the screen during flight.
Color of the horizon indicator line, in RGB hex format (e.g. 33CCFF).
Show the momentum crosshair widget when using momentum-based mouse mode.
config.really_radical_rolls.client.activ:
How the elytra rolling is activated.
Vanilla: starts with normal elytra flight.
Triple Jump: requires pressing jump 3 times to start.
Hybrid: hold jump while falling to activate.
Hybrid Toggle: press jump to toggle elytra on/off.
Standard elytra activation — rolling starts as soon as you glide.
Press jump three times in the air to activate elytra.
Hold jump while falling to activate elytra. Release jump to deactivate.
Press jump while falling to toggle elytra on. Press again to toggle off.
Automatically toggle elytra off after completing a full barrel roll in hybrid toggle mode.
config.really_radical_rolls.client.thrus: Enable forward/backward thrust during elytra flight. Use W/S keys to control.
Maximum speed cap for thrust-assisted flight.
How quickly thrust builds up when pressing forward (W key).
How much speed is reduced when pressing backward (S key).
Enable rolling during swimming. The player will bank when strafing underwater.
How strongly the player rolls when strafing left/right while swimming.
How strongly the player yaws when strafing left/right while swimming.
Apply smoothing to swimming roll movements for a more fluid feel.
Apply smoothing specifically to the strafe-induced roll and yaw.
Smoothing factor for pitch during swimming. Lower = smoother.
Smoothing factor for yaw during swimming. Lower = smoother.
Smoothing factor for roll during swimming. Lower = smoother.
config.really_radical_rolls.client.banki: Enable aerodynamic banking effects. The camera will tilt based on your flight path.
How strongly the banking effect tilts the camera.
Simulate control surfaces losing effectiveness at low speeds. Controls become less responsive when slow.
Automatically right the camera towards level when near center. Helps prevent over-rolling.
How strongly the automatic righting pulls the camera back to level.
config.really_radical_rolls.client.sensi: Smoothing applied to camera movements during flight. Higher values = smoother but less responsive.
Smoothing factor for pitch. 0 = instant response.
Smoothing factor for yaw. 0 = instant response.
Smoothing factor for roll. 0 = instant response.
Mouse/keyboard sensitivity settings for desktop play.
Pitch sensitivity multiplier for desktop input.
Yaw sensitivity multiplier for desktop input.
Roll sensitivity multiplier for desktop input.
Controller sensitivity settings for gamepad play.
Pitch sensitivity multiplier for controller input.
Yaw sensitivity multiplier for controller input.
Roll sensitivity multiplier for controller input.

config.really_radical_rolls.server.title: Server
config.really_radical_rolls.server.allow: Allow players to use thrust during elytra flight on this server.
config.really_radical_rolls.server.force: Force the mod to be enabled for all players, regardless of their client settings.
config.really_radical_rolls.server.kinet: How kinetic (collision) damage is handled during elytra flight.
Default Minecraft behavior — damage is applied normally.
Only apply kinetic damage at very high collision speeds.
Disable all kinetic damage during elytra flight.
Any collision during elytra flight is instantly lethal.
config.really_radical_rolls.expression.d: These formulas use a custom expression language. Use parentheses for grouping, and keep output in a sensible range for stable flight behavior.
config.really_radical_rolls.expression.u: Usage: write an expression with operators, variables ($name), functions (name(...)), and constants.
config.really_radical_rolls.expression.v:
- $pitch: Current pitch (degrees)
- $yaw: Current yaw (degrees)
- $roll: Current roll (degrees)
- $velocity_length: Current speed (blocks/tick)
- $velocity_x/$velocity_y/$velocity_z: Velocity vector components
- $look_x/$look_y/$look_z: Look vector components
- $banking_strength: Configured banking strength
config.really_radical_rolls.expression.f: sin(x) cos(x) tan(x) asin(x) acos(x) atan(x) sqrt(x) abs(x) ceil(x) floor(x) log(x) round(x) exp(x) min(x,y) max(x,y) randint(x[,y])

- sin/cos/tan: Trigonometric functions
- asin/acos/atan: Inverse trigonometric functions
- sqrt(x): Square root
- abs(x): Absolute value
- ceil(x)/floor(x)/round(x): Numeric rounding variants
- log(x): Natural logarithm
- exp(x): Exponential (e^x)
- min(x,y)/max(x,y): Smaller or larger value
- randint(max) or randint(min,max): Random integer range
config.really_radical_rolls.expression.c:
- PI: 3.1415926...
- E: 2.7182818...
- TO_RAD: Multiply degrees by this to convert to radians
- TO_DEG: Multiply radians by this to convert to degrees
config.really_radical_rolls.expression.o:
- + and -: Addition / subtraction
- * and /: Multiplication / division
- ^: Exponentiation
- ( ): Control evaluation order
- Unary + / - are supported (e.g. -$pitch)
